scripts.db:start: docker compose up -d --wait db auth migrate rest gateway
scripts.db:demo: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/demo.sql
scripts.db:bulk: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -d postgres -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/bulk.sql
scripts.db:types: docker compose run --rm -T types > apps/web/src/lib/database.types.ts.tmp && mv apps/web/src/lib/database.types.ts.tmp apps/web/src/lib/database.types.ts
